gloss: to forward; to transfer; to redirect

definitions.gloss: to forward (mail, email, data); to transfer; to redirect
definitions.explanation: To send something onward to a different address or destination. Used for mail, email, phone calls, and data.

examples.japanese: メールを{転送|てんそう}する。
{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}を{新|あたら}しい{住所|じゅうしょ}に{転送|てんそう}してもらった。
examples.english: I had my mail forwarded to my new address.

examples.japanese: この{書類|しょるい}を{担当者|たんとうしゃ}に{転送|てんそう}してください。
examples.english: Please forward this document to the person in charge.

notes:
A common word in both postal and digital communication contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メールを{転送|てんそう}する: to forward an email
- {郵便|ゆうびん}{転送|てんそう}: mail forwarding
- {転送|てんそう}{先|さき}: forwarding destination
- {転送|てんそう}{届|とどけ}: forwarding request/notification
- {電話|でんわ}{転送|てんそう}: call forwarding
- データ{転送|てんそう}: data transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {送|おく}る: to send — general, does not imply forwarding
- {回送|かいそう}する: to forward/route — used for vehicles or freight
- {送信|そうしん}する: to transmit — digital communication, original sending

USAGE:
When moving house, the Japanese postal service ({郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}) offers a free {転送|てんそう} service that redirects mail to your new address for one year. Submit a {転居届|てんきょとどけ} to activate it.
